# RxLoop

> Offline-first pharmaceutical middleware for Sub-Saharan Africa. RxLoop gives patients medication safety guidance in five Nigerian languages (English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yorùbá, Hausa, Igbo) with no internet connection, lets anyone flag a suspect medicine pack in seconds, and tracks dose reminders on the device. Free for patients. Revenue comes from pharmacies, manufacturers and regulators.

Important: RxLoop provides general safety and adherence guidance only. It never gives dosing figures, and it is not a substitute for a pharmacist or physician. Computer-vision pack verification is planned but not built; nothing on the site should be read as claiming it works today.

Founders: Nwosu Uzoma (Founder) and Robert Iheala (Co-founder). Based in Nigeria. Contact: uzomanwosu@rxloop.org (Nwosu Uzoma), robert.iheala@rxloop.org (Robert Iheala)

## Product
- [The app](https://rxloop.org/app/): the installable offline web app itself
- [Medication reference](https://rxloop.org/reference/): Look up common medicines in English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yorùbá, Hausa or Igbo. General safety guidance that works offline.
- [Reference data (JSON)](https://rxloop.org/data/medicines.json): all 14 medicines with guidance in all five languages
- [Report a pack](https://rxloop.org/report/): Flag a medicine pack that looks wrong in fifteen seconds, with no account. Stored on your device.
- [Reminders](https://rxloop.org/reminders/): Set dose times that fit your day and finish the whole course. Local reminders, no server, no data cost.
- [Product overview](https://rxloop.org/product/): What RxLoop does today, how it works offline, and what is still roadmap.

## Background
- [The gap](https://rxloop.org/gap/): Why falsified medicine reaches patients in Sub-Saharan Africa, and the one person in the supply chain nobody equips to check it.
- [The loop](https://rxloop.org/loop/): How patient reports travel back up the medicine supply chain to pharmacies, manufacturers and regulators.
- [Strategic blueprint](https://rxloop.org/blueprint/): The RxLoop strategic blueprint: problem, product, model, sequencing and what has to be true.
- [Strategic blueprint (PDF)](https://rxloop.org/RxLoop_Strategic_Blueprint_2026.pdf)
